description: Spoken requests over fleet.json, each turn scored on where its sends went (to), how many there were (sends: a count or [min, max]), and, for a question, whether the reply answered it (answer: strings the reply must contain), and, for a relay, what each send's text must hold (carries) and must not (omits). The first four are modelled on the Nov 20 failures, invented from scratch; the rest are controls, so that sending nothing cannot pass the suite.

cases.name: fleet_pr_rollcall
cases.why: A fleet-wide question was relayed to four agents, which each broadcast it to the fleet. Every pane's PRs are in the list: answer from it.

turns.say: Give me an overview of where all the PRs stand today. Ask all the panes what PRs they're managing.

cases.name: topic_matches_a_stale_pane
cases.why: A request with no window named went to a pane idle for days whose history shared its topic. Long-idle needs a confirm; the active pane is in the same repo.

turns.say: Make the webhook retry delay configurable too.

cases.name: go_for_it_with_nothing_pending
cases.why: A bare 'go for it' was typed into a pane that had asked nothing. Another pane's pending question is not this chat's to answer.

turns.say: Show me the release notes window.

cases.name: correction_names_the_right_pane
cases.why: A correction went to the same wrong pane as the send it corrected. Once the user says where, it goes there, and only there.

turns.say: Tell inbox sorter to rerun the flaky tests.
No, that was the wrong window. I meant invoice export, send it there.

cases.name: correction_without_a_target
cases.why: A rejected target is not sent to again: with no new window named, ask which.

turns.say: Tell inbox sorter to rerun the flaky tests.

cases.name: misheard_window_name
cases.why: The transcript misheard a window's name, and the relay carried the addressee to the agent, which went looking for a pane by that name. The words that pick the window are for the assistant; the agent gets the request.

turns.say: Tell the lantern surge pane to also index the changelog pages.

cases.name: correction_carries_a_request
cases.why: A correction of the assistant was relayed whole, so the agent got an argument about a word it never heard. It gets the request the correction carries.

turns.say: Tell release notes to add the migration guide link.
I never said release notes. I said invoice export, tell it to add the migration guide link.

cases.name: question_relay
cases.why: A question relayed in the assistant's own words went under the user's label, which is held to the user's words. Asking an agent is the assistant's own question to it.

turns.say: Ask release notes whether it covered the migration steps.

cases.name: named_window
cases.why: Control: a window named gets the words.

turns.say: Tell lantern search to also index the changelog pages.

cases.name: pr_number_routing
cases.why: Control: a repo and PR number find the pane that worked on it, over the active one.

turns.say: Ask the agent on orchard PR 322 to add a test for the time zone.

cases.name: answer_from_screen
cases.why: Control: what a screen shows is answered, not relayed.

turns.say: How far along is the kiln cache warm up?

cases.name: answer_a_named_menu
cases.why: Control: a yes to a named pane's pending question answers it, once.
